Leah: Thanks all for joining the town hall — I'm dropping a short follow-up here with Qs, clarifications, and owners. Recording + slides: https://redwood.example/ah-2026-03-22 (slides and recording).
Leah: High-level clarifications from the Q&A: Dedicated GA target is late Q3; Dedicated internal beta in July. Private (VPC/on-prem) progress continues — see infra ETA below.
Samir: Quick clarification on cost-optimizer: will this be enabled per-tenant or globally?
Leah: Per-tenant opt-in initially. We'll roll out canary windows and not flip customers without consent.
Priya: Who's handling the billing page copy for the opt-in UX? Need exact copy for the billing team and legal review.
Marco: I'll take docs + billing UX copy. Expect PR by 2026-03-29.
Cathy: I'll add console telemetry and the feature-flag UI on the Billing page. Target 2026-04-05.
Eli: For on-prem/air-gapped package timeline — can we give an ETA teams can plan around?
Leah: Current target: internal alpha in August, public preview  October (subject to infra readiness).
Samir: Can we get the canary rollout policy documented somewhere concise for SRE?
Leah: Yes, pasted below is the current plan:
```
rollout_policy:
  stage1: 5% traffic (1 week) - smoke + integration tests
  stage2: 25% traffic (2 weeks) - monitoring + cost/regression checks
  stage3: 100% gradual (1 week) - rollback if >10% error spike or >15% median latency increase
```
Samir: I'll coordinate on-call watch windows for stages and update the SLO incident doc.
